column1: # THE DIMENSION DEFINITIONS (the canonical frozen contract)
#   R0 STATE_BOUNDARY_COST      0..5
#   R1 SELFHOST_STAGE_LEVERAGE  0..3
#   R2 SEMANTIC_CENTRALITY      0..3
#   R3 PROOF_OBSERVABILITY      0..4
#   R4 DEPENDENCY_COUPLING_COST integer
#   R5 MIGRATION_SIZE           integer
#   R6 SOURCE_ORDER             file lexical asc, then line_start asc
# The comparator is a TOTAL order over the six dimensions, with R6
# compared as (file lexical, then line_start numeric).  It therefore
# does NOT depend on the input row order, which is what the ranker's
# own NC-06 control verifies.
# THE RECON05 DIMENSIONS ARE PRESERVED WHERE THE DECISION IS
# BYTE-UNCHANGED, AND REBOUND WHERE IT IS NOT
#   SUB-002   R0..R5 preserved (the condition at 1683..1684 is
#             BYTE-IDENTICAL to RECON05's recorded range)
#   SUB-004   R0..R5 preserved (the dispatch at 1773..1786 is
#             BYTE-IDENTICAL to RECON05's recorded range)
#   CAND-018  R0..R5 preserved (the decision is byte-unchanged; only
#             the RANGE CORRECTION changed, from 1328..1403 to the
#             true body 1328..1348)
#   CAND-021  R0..R5 preserved (likewise, 1352..1430 -> 1352..1375)
#             RECON05 CAND-022/023 R0 CORRECTION, carried forward)
#   CAND-023  R0..R5 preserved (798..818 -> 798..810; R0=1 likewise)
#   CAND-030  R0..R5 preserved (22..25 is already tight)
# R1..R5 describe the SEMANTIC SHAPE and the DEPENDENCY COUPLING of
# the decision, and the RANGE CORRECTION does not change that shape:
# the correction makes the range SPECIFIC to the decision, which is
# what the R4 coupling cost is supposed to describe.  No R1..R5 value
# was changed and no new dimension semantics were invented.
